name: Godrej Properties
strengths: Pristine brand trust, strong corporate balance sheet, advanced precast construction, and rigorous environmental compliance.
cautions: Charges a 15-20% brand premium; internal customization is strictly limited.

name: Prestige Group

flagship_projects.bengaluru: Prestige Falcon City, Prestige Lakeside Habitat, Prestige Somerville
flagship_projects.hyderabad: Prestige High Fields (Financial District), Prestige Beverly Hills

strengths: Market leader in South India with mammoth scale, proven on-time delivery across 170+ mn sqft, and high resale liquidity.
cautions: High society maintenance charges (₹4.5 - ₹6 per sqft) on massive amenity complexes.

name: Sobha Limited

flagship_projects.bengaluru: Sobha Iris, Sobha Dream Acres, Sobha Neopolis (Panathur)

strengths: Gold standard for German backward integration: in-house German glazing, precast, carpentry, and zero structural seepage.
cautions: Highest base price per sqft in category; firm non-negotiable payment schedules.

name: Brigade Group

flagship_projects.chennai: Brigade Residences at WTC (Perungudi), Brigade Xanadu
flagship_projects.hyderabad: Brigade Citadel (Moti Nagar), Brigade Gateway Neopolis

strengths: Pioneer of integrated multi-use townships combining World Trade Center offices, Orion retail, and green residences.
cautions: Handover timelines on ultra-large 40+ acre township phases can span 4-5 years.

name: Lodha / Macrotech Developers

flagship_projects.mumbai_mmr: The World Towers (Lower Parel), Lodha Park (Worli), Lodha Amara (Thane)

strengths: India's largest residential sales volume leader, iconic architectural landmarks, and luxury club amenities.
cautions: Higher density of units per acre in suburban developments; past debt overhang now resolved.

name: Oberoi Realty

flagship_projects.mumbai_mmr: Oberoi Sky City (Borivali), Oberoi Garden City (Goregaon), Three Sixty West (Worli)
flagship_projects.delhi_ncr: Oberoi Luxury Residences (Golf Course Ext, Gurugram)

strengths: Debt-free pristine balance sheet, unmatched construction craftsmanship, and prime high-elevation locations in Mumbai.
cautions: Premium ticket size (units rarely start below ₹3.5 - ₹4 Cr in Mumbai).

name: DLF Limited

flagship_projects.delhi_ncr: The Camellias (Gurugram), The Crest, DLF Cybercity, One Midtown (Moti Nagar)

strengths: Shaped modern Gurugram; institutional private fire stations, private roads, and ultra-luxury status symbol pedigree.
cautions: Very high minimum capital requirement; secondary market transfers attract steep premiums.

name: Tata Housing / Tata Realty

flagship_projects.delhi_ncr: Tata Primanti (Sec 72 Gurugram), Tata Gurgaon Gateway

strengths: Backed by the prestigious Tata Group; 100% transparent legal documentation and clear land titles.
cautions: Conservative project rollouts and steady rather than rapid execution speed.

name: Hiranandani Group

flagship_projects.mumbai_mmr: Hiranandani Gardens (Powai), Hiranandani Estate (Thane), Hiranandani Fortune City (Panvel)

strengths: Pioneered neoclassical European architecture with self-contained township ecosystems (schools, hospitals, retail).
cautions: Neoclassical exterior maintenance requires disciplined society upkeep.

name: Casagrand Builder Private Limited

flagship_projects.chennai: Casagrand Utopia (Manapakkam), Casagrand First City (Sholinganallur), Casagrand Zenith

strengths: Fastest turnaround cycle in South India, kid-centric and wellness-themed amenities, highly competitive pricing.
cautions: High unit density per tower; elevator wait times in large developments.

name: Aparna Constructions

flagship_projects.hyderabad: Aparna Serene Park (Gachibowli), Aparna Sarovar Zenith (Nallagandla), Aparna Cyber4

strengths: Unrivaled track record of zero-delay handovers in Hyderabad; in-house Aparna RMC batching, tiles, and aluminum frames.
cautions: Standardized utilitarian architectural elevations across multiple projects.

name: My Home Group

flagship_projects.hyderabad: My Home Bhooja (HITECH City), My Home Sayuk (Tellapur), My Home Avali, My Home Mangala

strengths: Hyderabad's benchmark for prime IT location acquisitions, precast engineering speed, and huge resale capital retention.
cautions: Focus remains strictly concentrated in the Hyderabad micro-market.

name: Eldeco Group

flagship_projects.varanasi_100km: Eldeco Surya Greens (Shivpur, Varanasi), Eldeco Shaurya, Eldeco City
flagship_projects.delhi_ncr: Eldeco Live Neoma (Sector 150 Noida), Eldeco Utopia

strengths: Decades-long undisputed leadership across Uttar Pradesh cities; pristine delivery record in Tier 2/3 markets.
cautions: Slower marketing digitization compared to southern Tier-1 giants.

name: Omaxe Limited

flagship_projects.varanasi_100km: Omaxe Heights (Civil Lines, Prayagraj), Omaxe Eternity
flagship_projects.delhi_ncr: Omaxe Chowk (Chandni Chowk), Omaxe Palm Greens

strengths: Pioneered integrated township model and multi-storey towers in cities like Prayagraj and Lucknow.
cautions: Some past projects faced delayed handover; verify specific project RERA registration status.

name: Puravankara Limited / Provident

flagship_projects.chennai: Purva Windermere (Pallikaranai peripheral), Purva Somerset House (Guindy)

strengths: BluNex smart home automation integration, strong brand presence, and diversified price tiers (Provident for affordable).
cautions: Carefully inspect localized approach roads in peripheral projects.

name: Mahindra Lifespaces
strengths: Net-zero green building champion; backed by Mahindra Group ethics, IGBC Platinum certifications.
cautions: Selectively launches fewer projects per year, maintaining boutique exclusivity.
